name: [BIG UPD] 🏍️ Wheelie District
desc:
🏍️ Welcome to Wheelie District — Where the streets reward skill and the bikelife never stops. 🏍️

🔥 The NEW Update is out! Many new features have been added! Use code "UPDATE6" for FREE Rewards!

Grab your ride, explore the map, and hold smooth wheelies 🤙, chain clean combos 💥, and flex your control. This isn’t a race — it’s a full rideout experience.

💸 Earn Cash While You Drive: Hold longer wheelies, build multipliers, and turn skill into money.
🛠️ Unlock better bikes and cars, improve performance, and create your perfect build.
👥 Ride solo or team up and take over the streets together.
🎯 Dial in your balance, throttle, and timing to maximize every run.

🌆 Ride dirtbikes, sportbikes, cars, scooters, mopeds, motard supermotos, e-bikes, minibikes, e-scooters and many different motorcycles! — each with unique handling and feel.
🔓 Unlock vehicles, upgrade your collection, and dominate the district.
